V5_DESC: 6,600 s (110 min) measured: x^p mod g 114 s, 22 compositions at about 300 s each, two gcds and the reductions modulo f about 10 s; peak memory 2.8 GB
TOTAL_DESC: 6,635 s (about 111 min, 1.9 h) measured, one core, pure Python with flint (BelowNormal priority on a shared machine)
VERIFY_SHORT: two hours on one core in pure Python with flint
RUN_STATUS: The complete run of the shipped verifier on the final data finished with all PASS lines in 6,635 s: deg gcd(g, x^(p^l) - x) = 20271 and deg gcd(g, x^p - x) = 2 (so the degree-l part has degree 20269), and the printed SHA-256 of f, u and R_0..R_14 mod f equal the tables of sec. 8.6.3. The team's compiled engine (C/CUDA, not part of the package) did the equivalent chain modulo f in 6.7 s on one RTX 3090; the referee time is therefore about two hours in pure Python, not minutes.
